Ops noticed the nightly export sometimes skips the last customer. It might be the pagination. Please look into it.
Users in Sydney see yesterday's date on their dashboard until about 10am.
The search box returns nothing when the query has an apostrophe, e.g. O'Brien.
Since Tuesday's deploy, about 1 in 50 uploads end up as zero-byte files.
QA reports the cart badge shows 3 items while the cart page lists 2.
Invoices for Swiss customers are rounded to the wrong 5 cents. Accounting thinks it is the currency table.
Our CI run is red on main and nobody knows why; the failing test is test/orders.test.mjs.
When two admins edit the same page at once, one of the edits silently disappears.
The notification service is copy-pasted across three handlers. Pull the common part into one module without changing what any handler sends.
src/billing.mjs is 900 lines and mixes tax, discounts and formatting. Break it into smaller modules, keeping every export working as before.
Replace the chain of if/else on order status with a lookup table. Behaviour must stay the same.
Rename `usr` to `user` throughout the auth code.
The validation helpers in forms/ and api/ do the same thing in two slightly different ways. Merge them into one.
Turn the callback-based mailer into async/await, same behaviour.
Let admins export the audit log as CSV, filtered by date range. Invalid dates return a 400 with code bad_range.
We need a /health endpoint that reports the database and cache status as JSON.

Customers should be able to pause a subscription for up to three months. A paused subscription is not billed, and resuming bills from the resume date. Paused subscriptions that pass three months resume on their own.
Add an optional note field to orders, up to 500 characters. Longer notes are rejected with a 422 error.
Webhooks: sign every outgoing payload with HMAC-SHA256 and put the signature in X-Signature. Receivers that fail verification should get documentation on how to check it.
Introduce per-team API quotas. Over-quota calls get a 429 error with a Retry-After header. Everything else keeps working exactly as it does now.
Show a banner to users whose password is older than a year, linking to the change-password page.
Support SSO login via Google for workspace accounts.
Make the export job resumable so a crash halfway through does not start from scratch.
Teams want a weekly digest email listing open tasks per assignee, sent Monday 8am in each user's time zone.
